s.d: κραταιός, -ά, -όν (κράτος), (in cl. poët, form of κρατερός), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק and cognates ;] strong, mighty: [[1-peter 5 6|1Pe.5:6.]]† (AS)

κραταιόω, -ῶ (late form of κρατύνω; κράτος) [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;] to strengthen; pass., to wax strong: [[luke 2 40|Luk.2:40]], [[1-corinthians 16 13|1Co.16:13]]; πνεύματι, [[luke 1 80|Luk.1:80;]] δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, [[ephesians 3 16|Eph.3:16.]]† (AS)

κρατέω, -ῶ (κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק hi., also for אָחַז, etc. ;] 1. to be strong, mighty, hence, to rule, be master, prevail (so chiefly in cl.; in LXX: [[esther 1 1|Est.1:1]], I [[esther 4 38|Est.4:38]], Wis.14:19, al.). 2. to get possession of, obtain, take hold of (Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive of thing(s) (M, Pr., 65), [[acts 27 13|Act.27:13;]] τ. χειρός, [[matthew 9 25|Mat.9:25]], [[mark 1 31|Mrk.1:31 5:41 9:27]], [[luke 8 54|Luk.8:54]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 12 11|Mat.12:11;]] with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 14 3|Mat.14:3 18:28 21:46 22:6 26:4, 48]] ff., [[mark 3 21|Mrk.3:21 6:17 12:12 14:1, 44]] ff, [[acts 3 11|Act.3:11 24:6]], [[revelation 20 2|Rev.20:2]] (cf. [[2-samuel 6 6|2Ki.6:6]]). 3. to hold, hold fast (Æsch., Polyb., al.): with accusative of thing(s), ἐν τ. δεξιᾷ, [[revelation 2 1|Rev.2:1.]] Metaphorical: with accusative of person(s), pass., [[acts 2 24|Act.2:24;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[revelation 2 13|Rev.2:13, 25 3:11]]; τ. κεφαλήν (i.e. Christ), [[colossians 2 19|Col.2:19;]] τ. παράδοσιν (-εις), λόγον, διδαχήν, [[mark 7 3|Mrk.7:3-4, 8 9:10]], [[2-thessalonians 2 15|2Th.2:15]], [[revelation 2 14|Rev.2:14-15]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[hebrews 4 14|Heb.4:14 6:18]]; of sins, to retain, [[john 20 23|Jhn.20:23;]] of re­straint, before ἵνα μή, [[revelation 7 1|Rev.7:1;]] pass., before τοῦ μή, [[luke 24 16|Luk.24:16.]]† (AS)

κράτιστος, -η, -ον superl, of κρατύς (Hom.), 1. strongest, mightiest (Hom.). 2. noblest, best (cf. κρείσσων), most excellent (find., Soph., al.): voc., κρατίστε, as title of honour and respect (DCG, ii, 727a), [[luke 1 3|Luk.1:3]], [[acts 23 26|Act.23:26 24:3 26:25]].† (AS)

κράτος, -εος (-ους), τό [in LXX chiefly for עֹז, [[job 12 16|Job.12:16]], [[psalms 90 11|Psa.90:11]] al. ;] 1. strength, esp. as in Hom., of bodily strength. 2. power, might: [[hebrews 2 14|Heb.2:14;]] τὸ κ. τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ, [[ephesians 1 19|Eph.1:19 6:10]] ([[isaiah 40 26|Isa.40:26]], Da TH [[daniel 4 27|Dan.4:27]]); τ. δόςης αὐτοῦ, [[colossians 1 11|Col.1:11;]] κατὰ κράτος, mightily, [[acts 19 20|Act.19:20;]] a mighty deed, an act of power, [[luke 1 51|Luk.1:51;]] in doxologies, [[1-timothy 6 16|1Ti.6:16]], [[1-peter 4 11|1Pe.4:11 5:11]], Ju 25, [[revelation 1 6|Rev.1:6 5:13]].† (AS)

κραυγάζω (κραυγή) [in LXX: [[esther 3 13|Est.3:13]] (רוּעַ hi.)* ;] = κράζω 1. of animals, to bay, to croak, etc. 2. Of men, to cry out, shout: [[matthew 12 19|Mat.12:19]], [[john 12 13|Jhn.12:13 19:15]] [[acts 22 23|Act.22:23]]; before λέγων, [[john 18 40|Jhn.18:40 19:6, 12]]; καὶ λέγων, [[luke 4 41|Luk.4:41]] (WH, κράζ -); φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, [[john 11 43|Jhn.11:43]] (cf. Abbott, JV, 269 f.).† (AS)

κραυγή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX for צְוָחָה, תְּרוּעָה, שַׁוְעָה, etc. ;] crying, outcry, clamour: [[matthew 25 6|Mat.25:6]], [[luke 1 42|Luk.1:42]], [[acts 23 9|Act.23:9]], [[ephesians 4 31|Eph.4:31]], [[hebrews 5 7|Heb.5:7]], [[revelation 21 4|Rev.21:4]].† (AS)
κρέας, -έως, pl., κρέα [in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.) ;] flesh, meat: [[romans 14 21|Rom.14:21]], [[1-corinthians 8 13|1Co.8:13]].† (AS)

κρείσσων (Epic and old Att..) and κρείττων (later Att..), prop. comparat. of κρατύς, strong, but in sense often (as in cl., see LS, see word) as comparat. of ἀγαθός, [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;] better; (a) as to ad­vantage or usefulness: [[1-corinthians 11 17|1Co.11:17]], [[hebrews 11 40|Heb.11:40 12:24]]; πολλῷ μᾶλλον κ., [[philippians 1 23|Php.1:23;]] κρεῖσσον ποιεῖν, [[1-corinthians 7 38|1Co.7:38;]] ἐστιν, before inf., [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9]], [[2-peter 2 21|2Pe.2:21]]; (b) as to excellence: [[hebrews 1 4|Heb.1:4 6:9 7:7, 19 7:22 8:6 9:23 10:34 11:16, 35]]; κ. ἐστι, before inf., [[1-peter 3 17|1Pe.3:17.]]† (AS)

κρείσσων (Epic and old Att..) and κρείττων (later Att..), prop. comparat. of κρατύς, strong, but in sense often (as in cl., see LS, see word) as comparat. of ἀγαθός, [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;] better; (a) as to ad­vantage or usefulness: [[1-corinthians 11 17|1Co.11:17]], [[hebrews 11 40|Heb.11:40 12:24]]; πολλῷ μᾶλλον κ., [[philippians 1 23|Php.1:23;]] κρεῖσσον ποιεῖν, [[1-corinthians 7 38|1Co.7:38;]] ἐστιν, before inf., [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9]], [[2-peter 2 21|2Pe.2:21]]; (b) as to excellence: [[hebrews 1 4|Heb.1:4 6:9 7:7, 19 7:22 8:6 9:23 10:34 11:16, 35]]; κ. ἐστι, before inf., [[1-peter 3 17|1Pe.3:17.]]† (AS)

κρεμάννυμι (also κρεμαννύω, κρεμάω; the Pres. is not found in NT), [in LXX (where also κρεμάζω, [[job 26 7|Job.26:7]]) chiefly for תָּלָה ;] trans., to hang, suspend: with accusative of person(s), before ἐπὶ ξύλου, [[acts 5 30|Act.5:30 10:39]]; pass., [[luke 23 39|Luk.23:39;]] before περί, [[matthew 18 6|Mat.18:6.]] Mid., κρέμαμαι, intrans., to hang: before ἐκ, [[acts 28 4|Act.28:4;]] ἐπὶ ξύλου, [[galatians 3 13|Gal.3:13]] (LXX); metaphorically, before ἐν, [[matthew 22 40|Mat.22:40.]]† (AS)
κρημνός, -οῦ, ὁ (κρεμάννυμι), [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 25 12|2Ch.25:12]] (סֶלַע)* ;] a steep bank: [[matthew 8 32|Mat.8:32]], [[mark 5 13|Mrk.5:13]], [[luke 8 33|Luk.8:33]].† (AS)
Κρής, ὁ, pl., Κρῆτες a Cretan: [[acts 2 11|Act.2:11]], [[titus 1 12|Tit.1:12]].† (AS)
Κρήσκης, -εντος (BI., § 10, 4), ὁ Crescens: [[2-timothy 4 10|2Ti.4:10.]]† (AS)
κριθή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה ;] barley: pl. (as usually in cl.), [[revelation 6 6|Rev.6:6.]]† (AS)
κρίθινος, -η, -ον (κριθή), [in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה ;] of barley: [[john 6 9|Jhn.6:9, 13]] (AS)

κρίμα (B1., § 27, 2), -τος, τό (κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט ;] the issue of a judicial process, hence, 1. judgment, the decision passed on the faults of others: [[matthew 7 2|Mat.7:2;]] in forensic sense, with genitive pun., [[luke 24 20|Luk.24:20;]] esp. of the judgment of God, [[romans 2 2|Rom.2:2 5:16 11:33]] (ICC, in l), [[2-peter 2 3|2Pe.2:3]], Ju 4; κ. λαμβάνεσθαι, [[matthew 23 13|Mat.23:13]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[mark 12 40|Mrk.12:40]], [[luke 20 47|Luk.20:47]], [[romans 13 2|Rom.13:2]], [[james 3 1|Jas.3:1]]; ἔχειν, [[1-timothy 5 12|1Ti.5:12;]] βαστάζειν, [[galatians 5 10|Gal.5:10;]] ἐσθίειν ἑαυτῷ, [[1-corinthians 11 29|1Co.11:29;]] εἰς κ. συνέρχεσθαι, [[1-corinthians 11 34|1Co.11:34;]] εἶναι ἐν τ αὐτῷ κ., [[luke 23 40|Luk.23:40;]] with genitive obj., [[romans 3 8|Rom.3:8]], [[1-timothy 3 6|1Ti.3:6]], [[revelation 17 1|Rev.17:1]]; of God's judgment through Christ, [[john 9 39|Jhn.9:39;]] τὸ κ. ἄρχεται, [[1-peter 4 17|1Pe.4:17;]] τ. κ. τ. μέλλον, [[acts 24 25|Act.24:25;]] κ. αἰώνιον, [[hebrews 6 2|Heb.6:2;]] ἔκρινεν ὁ Θεὸς τ. κ. ὐμῶν, [[revelation 18 20|Rev.18:20;]] of the right of judgment, [[revelation 20 4|Rev.20:4.]] 2. a matter for judgment, a law-suit, a case: [[1-corinthians 6 7|1Co.6:7.]]† (AS)
κρίνον, -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for שׁוּשַׁן ;] a lily: [[matthew 6 28|Mat.6:28]], [[luke 12 27|Luk.12:27]].† (AS)

κρίνω, [in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for ריב ,דּין, etc. ;] 1. to separate, select, choose (cl.; in LXX: 2Ma.13:15). 2. to approve, esteem: [[romans 14 5|Rom.14:5.]] 3. to be of opinion, judge, think: [[luke 7 43|Luk.7:43]], [[1-corinthians 11 13|1Co.11:13]]; before τοῦτο ὅτι, [[2-corinthians 5 14|2Co.5:14;]] with accusative and inf., [[acts 16 15|Act.16:15;]] with accusative and pred., [[acts 13 46|Act.13:46 26:8]]. 4. to decide, determine, decree: with accusative, [[acts 16 4|Act.16:4]], [[romans 14 13|Rom.14:13]], [[1-corinthians 7 37|1Co.7:37]], [[2-corinthians 2 1|2Co.2:1]]; with inf. (Field, Notes, 167), [[acts 20 16|Act.20:16 25:25]], [[1-corinthians 2 2|1Co.2:2 5:3]], [[titus 3 12|Tit.3:12]] (cf. 1Ma.11:33, Wis.8:9, al.); with accusative and inf., [[acts 21 25|Act.21:25 27:1]]. 5. to judge, adjudge, pronounce judgment: absol., [[john 8 16|Jhn.8:16, 26]]; before κατά, with accusative, [[john 7 24|Jhn.7:24 8:15]]; κρίσιν κ., [[john 7 24|Jhn.7:24;]] τ. δίκαιον, [[luke 12 57|Luk.12:57]] (Deiss., LAE, 118); in forensic sense, [[john 18 31|Jhn.18:31]], [[acts 23 3|Act.23:3]], al.; pass., [[romans 3 4|Rom.3:4]] (LXX); of God's judgment, [[john 5 30|Jhn.5:30 8:50]], [[romans 2 16|Rom.2:16 3:6]], [[2-timothy 4 1|2Ti.4:1]], [[1-peter 4 5|1Pe.4:5]], al. 6. = κατακρίνω, to condemn (cl.): [[acts 13 27|Act.13:27;]] of God's judgment, [[john 3 18|Jhn.3:18 5:22 12:47, 48]], [[acts 7 7|Act.7:7]], [[romans 2 12|Rom.2:12]], [[1-corinthians 11 32|1Co.11:32]], [[hebrews 10 30|Heb.10:30]]" (LXX), [[james 5 9|Jas.5:9]], [[revelation 19 2|Rev.19:2]], al. 7. As in LXX (for שׁפט), to rule, govern ( 4Ki.15:5, [[psalms 2 10|Psa.2:10]], al.): [[matthew 19 28|Mat.19:28]], [[luke 22 30|Luk.22:30]], [[1-corinthians 6 3|1Co.6:3]]. 8. to bring to trial (cl.); mid., to go to law: with dative of person(s), [[matthew 5 40|Mat.5:40;]] before μετά, with genitive of person(s) (of the opponent), ἐπί, with genitive (of the judge), [[1-corinthians 6 1|1Co.6:1]], 6 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἀντ-απο- (-μαι), δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συν-, ὑπο- (-μαι), συν-υπο- (-μαι)). SYN.: see: δικάστης. (AS)

κρίσις, -εως, ἡ (κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, also for רִיב, etc. ;] 1. a seperating, selection (Arist., al.) 2. a decision, judgment (cl.): [[john 8 16|Jhn.8:16]], [[1-timothy 5 24|1Ti.5:24]], [[2-peter 2 11|2Pe.2:11]], Ju 9; κ. κρίνειν, [[john 7 24|Jhn.7:24;]] in forensic sense, [[acts 8 33|Act.8:33]] (LXX) (see Page, in l); esp. of the Divine judgment, [[john 3 19|Jhn.3:19 5:24, 27 5:29-30 12:31 16:8, 11]], [[2-thessalonians 1 5|2Th.1:5]], [[hebrews 10 27|Heb.10:27]], [[james 2 13|Jas.2:13 5:12]], [[2-peter 2 4|2Pe.2:4]], [[revelation 18 10|Rev.18:10]]; pl., [[revelation 16 7|Rev.16:7 19:2]]; of the last judgment, [[matthew 10 15|Mat.10:15 11:22, 24 12:36, 41-42]] [[luke 10 14|Luk.10:14 11:31-32]], [[hebrews 9 27|Heb.9:27]], [[2-peter 2 9|2Pe.2:9 3:7]], [[1-john 4 17|1Jn.4:17]], Ju 6 15; τῆς γεέννης, [[matthew 23 33|Mat.23:33.]] 3. By meton. (as in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, [[isaiah 5 7|Isa.5:7]], al.; דִּישׁוֹן, [[daniel 7 10|Dan.7:10]]), of the standard of judgment, right, justice: [[matthew 12 18|Mat.12:18, 20]] (LXX, [[isaiah 42 43|Isa 42:43]]) [[isaiah 23 23|Isa 23:23]], [[luke 11 42|Luk.11:42;]] of the tribunal (a local court), [[matthew 5 21|Mat.5:21-22]]† (AS)
Κρίσπος, -ου, ὁ Crispus: [[acts 18 8|Act.18:8]], [[1-corinthians 1 14|1Co.1:14]].† (AS)

κριτήριον, -ου, τό (κριτής), [in LXX: [[1-kings 7 7|3Ki.7:7]] (מִשְׁפָּט), Dan LXX TH [[daniel 7 10|Dan.7:10, 26]], (דִּין), Su 1:49, [[exodus 21 6|Exo.21:6]], [[judges 5 10|Jdg.5:10]] * ;] 1. a means of judging, test, criterion. 2. a tribunal: [[1-corinthians 6 2|1Co.6:2 6:4]], [[james 2 6|Jas.2:6]].† (AS)

κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ (κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַט ;] a judge: [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25]], [[luke 12 14|Luk.12:14, 58 18:2]]; τ. ἀδικίας, [[luke 18 6|Luk.18:6;]] with gem of thing(s) (obj.), [[acts 18 15|Act.18:15]], [[james 4 11|Jas.4:11]]; (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, [[james 2 4|Jas.2:4;]] of a Roman procurator, [[acts 24 10|Act.24:10;]] of God, [[hebrews 12 23|Heb.12:23]], [[james 4 12|Jas.4:12]]; Christ, [[acts 10 42|Act.10:42]], [[2-timothy 4 8|2Ti.4:8]], [[james 5 9|Jas.5:9]]; of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, [[matthew 12 27|Mat.12:27]], [[luke 11 19|Luk.11:19]]; in the OT sense ([[judges 2 16|Jdg.2:16]], [[ruth 1 1|Rut.1:1]], al), of a ruler in Israel, [[acts 13 20|Act.13:20.]]† SYN.: δικάστης, q.v (AS)
κριτικός, -ή, -όν (κρίνω), critical, able to discern or judge: with genitive obj., [[hebrews 4 12|Heb.4:12.]]† (AS)

Κρούω [in LXX: before ἐπί [[judges 19 22|Jdg.19:22]], [[song-of-solomon 5 2|Sng.5:2]] (דָּפַק) ;] with, accusative, τ. αὐλαίαν, Jdth.14:14 * ;] to strike, knock: at a door (Κόπτειν, in Att..), [[matthew 7 7|Mat.7:7-8]], [[luke 11 9|Luk.11:9-10 12:36]], [[acts 12 16|Act.12:16]], [[revelation 3 20|Rev.3:20]]; with accusative, τ. θύραν, [[luke 13 25|Luk.13:25]], [[acts 12 13|Act.12:13]].† (AS)
κρύπτη (WH, R; κρυπτή, LT, Tr.; -όν, Rec.), -ης, ἡ, a crypt, cellar: [[luke 11 33|Luk.11:33.]]† (AS)

κρυπτός, -ή, -όν (κρύπτω) [in LXX for אָטַם, מִסְתָּר, etc. ;] hidden, secret: [[matthew 10 26|Mat.10:26]], [[mark 4 22|Mrk.4:22]], [[luke 8 17|Luk.8:17 12:2]]; ὁ κ. τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος, [[1-peter 3 4|1Pe.3:4;]] neut., ἐν τῷ κ., [[matthew 6 4|Mat.6:4]], 6; ἐν κ., [[john 7 4|Jhn.7:4, 10 18:20]]; ὁ ἐν κ. Ἰουδαῖος, [[romans 2 29|Rom.2:29;]] pl., τὰ κ. τ. σκότους, [[1-corinthians 4 5|1Co.4:5;]] τ. ἀνθρώπων, [[romans 2 16|Rom.2:16;]] τ. καρδίας, [[1-corinthians 14 25|1Co.14:25;]] τ. αἰσχύνης, [[2-corinthians 4 2|2Co.4:2.]]† κρυφαῖος, -αία, -αῖον (κρύφα = κρυφῆ) [in LXX for מִסְתָּר, [[jeremiah 23 24|Jer.23:24]], al. ;] hidden, secret: ἐν τῷ κ., [[matthew 6 18|Mat.6:18.]]† (AS)

Κρύπτω [in LXX for חָבָא, טָמַן, סָתַר, צָפַן, etc. ;] to hide, conceal: with accusative, [[matthew 13 44|Mat.13:44 25:18]]; before ἐν, [[matthew 25 25|Mat.25:25]] (pass., [[matthew 13 44|Mat.13:44]], [[colossians 3 3|Col.3:3]]); pass., [[matthew 5 14|Mat.5:14]], [[hebrews 11 23|Heb.11:23]], [[1-timothy 5 25|1Ti.5:25]], [[revelation 2 17|Rev.2:17]]; ἐκρύβη (on the tense and its formation, see M, Pr., 161; Bl., § 19, 3) κ. ἐξῆλθεν [[john 8 59|Jhn.8:59;]] before εἰς, [[luke 13 21|Luk.13:21]], [[revelation 6 15|Rev.6:15]]; ἀπό (in cl. more frequently dupl. accusative), [[revelation 6 16|Rev.6:16;]] pass., [[john 12 36|Jhn.12:36]], (Bl., § 34, 4). Metaphorical: [[matthew 11 25|Mat.11:25 13:35]], [[luke 11 52|Luk.11:52]], WH, mg., [[luke 18 34|Luk.18:34 19:42]], [[john 19 38|Jhn.19:38]] (cf.ἀτο-, ἐν-, περι-κρύπτω).† (AS)
κρυσταλλίζω (κρύσταλλος), to shine like crystal, be crystal-clear: [[revelation 21 11|Rev.21:11]] (ἅπ, λεγ.).† (AS)
κρύσταλλος, -ου, ὁ (κρύος, frost), [in LXX: [[job 38 29|Job.38:29]], [[psalms 147 17|Psa.147:17]], [[ezekiel 1 22|Eze.1:22]] (קֶרַח), etc. ;] crystal: [[revelation 4 6|Rev.4:6 22:1]].† (AS)
κρυΦῇ (prop. -ῆ, Rec.; later spelling is due to assimilation to dative; cf. εἰκῆ), adv., [in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;] secretly, in secret: [[ephesians 5 12|Eph.5:12.]]† (AS)

κτάομαι, -ῶμαι [in LXX chiefly for קָנָה ;] in pres., impf., fut. and aor., to procure for oneself, get, gain, acquire (the pf. and plpf., to have acquired, hence to possess, do not occur in NT): with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 10 9|Mat.10:9]], [[luke 18 12|Luk.18:12]], [[acts 8 20|Act.8:20]]; with genitive pret., [[acts 22 28|Act.22:28;]] ἐκ with genitive pret., [[acts 1 18|Act.1:18;]] τ,ψυχὰς ὑμῶν (MM, xvi), [[luke 21 19|Luk.21:19;]] τ. ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι, [[1-thessalonians 4 4|1Th.4:4]] (where if σ. = body, κ. must = pf., κέκτημαι; see MM, xvi; M, Th., in l; Field, Notes, 72 f. But σ. is most frequently taken as = wife; see Thayer, see word; Lft., Notes, 53 ff.; ICC, in l).† (AS)
κτῆμα, -τος, τό (κτάομαι), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם, etc. ;] a possession, property: [[matthew 19 22|Mat.19:22]], [[mark 10 22|Mrk.10:22]], [[acts 2 45|Act.2:45 5:1]].† (AS)

κτῆνος, -ους, τό (κτάομαι, hence primarily a possession), [in LXX chiefly for בְּהֵמָה [[genesis 1 25|Gen.1:25]], al., also for מִקְנֶה, צֹנֵא, etc. ;] a beast, (in late Gk. esp.) a beast of burden: [[luke 10 34|Luk.10:34]] pl. (as chiefly in cl.), [[acts 23 24|Act.23:24]], [[revelation 18 13|Rev.18:13]]; of quadrupeds, as Opp. to fishes and birds (cf. Ge, l.with), [[1-corinthians 15 39|1Co.15:39.]]† (AS)
κτήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ (κτάομαι) [in Sm.: [[joel 1 11|Jol.1:11]] * ;] a possessor: [[acts 4 34|Act.4:34.]]† (AS)

κτίζω [in LXX chiefly for בָּרָא, [[psalms 51 10|Psa.51:10]], al.; also for קָנָה, [[genesis 14 19|Gen.14:19]], [[proverbs 8 22|Pro.8:22]]; יָצַר, [[isaiah 22 11|Isa.22:11 46:11]]; Wis.2:23, Sir.1:4, 9 (and freq.), I [[esther 4 53|Est.4:53]], a1. ;] 1. in cl., to people or found a region or city (1Es, l.with). 2. In LXX and NT, of God, to create: [[mark 13 19|Mrk.13:19]], [[1-corinthians 11 9|1Co.11:9]], [[colossians 1 16|Col.1:16 3:10]] [[ephesians 3 9|Eph.3:9]], [[1-timothy 4 3|1Ti.4:3]], [[revelation 4 11|Rev.4:11 10:6]]; ὁ κτίσας, [[matthew 19 4|Mat.19:4]] (WH, R, mg.), [[romans 1 25|Rom.1:25;]] of the divine operation on the soul, [[ephesians 2 10|Eph.2:10, 15 4:24]] (cf. Ps., l.with).† (AS)

λαλέω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for דּבר pi., also for אמר, etc. ;] 1. to utter: of inanimate things, [[revelation 4 1|Rev.4:1 10:4]]; metaphorically, [[hebrews 11 4|Heb.11:4 12:24]]. 2. to talk, speak, say: absol., [[matthew 9 33|Mat.9:33 12:46]], [[mark 5 35|Mrk.5:35]], [[luke 8 49|Luk.8:49]]; before ὡς, [[1-corinthians 13 11|1Co.13:11]], [[revelation 13 11|Rev.13:11]]; εἰς, [[1-corinthians 14 9|1Co.14:9;]] ἐκ, [[matthew 12 34|Mat.12:34;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 10 19|Mat.10:19]], [[mark 11 32|Mrk.11:32]], [[john 8 30|Jhn.8:30]], al.; with dative of person(s), [[matthew 12 46|Mat.12:46]], [[luke 24 6|Luk.24:6]], [[romans 7 1|Rom.7:1]], al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[matthew 9 18|Mat.9:18]], [[john 10 6|Jhn.10:6]], al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, [[mark 6 50|Mrk.6:50]], [[luke 1 19|Luk.1:19 2:33]], al.; ἐν, ἐξ, ἀπό, [[matthew 13 3|Mat.13:3]], [[john 12 49|Jhn.12:49 14:10]], al.; λ. τ. λόγον, [[mark 8 32|Mrk.8:32]], al.; before orat. dir. (not cl.), [[mark 14 31|Mrk.14:31]], [[hebrews 5 5|Heb.5:5 11:18]]; Hebraistically (Dalman, Words, 25f.), ἐλάλησε λέγων, [[matthew 14 27|Mat.14:27]], [[john 8 12|Jhn.8:12]], [[acts 8 26|Act.8:26]], al. SYN.: see: λέγω. (AS)
λαλία, -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, דִּבְרָה ;] 1. loquacity = Very talkative. 2. talk, speech, conversation: [[matthew 26 73|Mat.26:73]] (cf. Ca 43), [[john 4 42|Jhn.4:42 8:43]].† (AS)
λαμά (Heb. מָה, seel. λεμά = Aram. לְמָא) why: [[matthew 27 46|Mat.27:46]] (WH, mg., λεμά TTr., WH, txt., λεμά L), [[mark 15 34|Mrk.15:34]] (λεμά LT, λαμμᾶ, Rec.).† (AS)

λαμβάνω, [in LXX chiefly for לקח, also for אחז ,לכד ,נשׂא, etc. ;] 1. to take, lay hold of: absol., [[matthew 26 26|Mat.26:26]], [[mark 14 22|Mrk.14:22]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 5 40|Mat.5:40 26:52]], al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 21 35|Mat.21:35]], [[mark 12 3|Mrk.12:3]], al.; pleonastic λαβών (M, Pr., 230; Bl., §74, 2), [[matthew 13 31|Mat.13:31 14:19]], al.; so also indic., [[mark 7 27|Mrk.7:27]], [[john 19 1|Jhn.19:1, 40]] [[revelation 8 5|Rev.8:5]], al.; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), ἀφορμήν, [[romans 7 8|Rom.7:8, 11]]; ὑδόδειγμα, [[james 5 10|Jas.5:10;]] id. with accusative of person(s), φόβος, [[luke 7 16|Luk.7:16;]] πνεῦμα, [[luke 9 39|Luk.9:39;]] πειρασμός, [[1-corinthians 10 13|1Co.10:13;]] aoristic pf. (M, Pr., 145, 238; BL, §59, 4), [[revelation 5 7|Rev.5:7 8:5]], al. 2. to receive: absol., opposite to αἰτεῖν, [[matthew 7 8|Mat.7:8]], al.; διδόναι, [[matthew 10 8|Mat.10:8]], [[acts 20 35|Act.20:35]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 27 6|Mat.27:6]], [[mark 10 3|Mrk.10:3]]o, al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), [[john 6 21|Jhn.6:21 13:20 19:27]], 2Jo.10; ῥαπίσμασιν (a vulgarism; Bl., §38, 3), [[mark 14 65|Mrk.14:65;]] metaphorically, τ. λόγον, [[matthew 13 20|Mat.13:20]], [[mark 4 16|Mrk.4:16]]; τ. μαρτυρίαν, [[john 3 11|Jhn.3:11;]] τ. ῥήματα, [[john 12 48|Jhn.12:48;]] πρόσωπον (Heb. נָשָׂא פָּנִים, Dalman, Words, 30), [[luke 20 21|Luk.20:21]], [[galatians 2 6|Gal.2:6]]; ζωὴν αἰώνιον (Dalman, op. cit., 124f.), [[mark 10 30|Mrk.10:30]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, συν-αντι- (-μαι), ἀπο-, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, συν-περι-, ὑπο-λαμβάνω). (AS)
Λάμεχ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. לֶמֶךְ), Lamech ([[genesis 5 25|Gen.5:25]]): [[luke 3 36|Luk.3:36]].† (AS)

λαμπάς, -άδος, ἡ (λάμπω), [in LXX for לַפִּיד ;] a torch (frequently fed, like a lamp, with oil): [[matthew 25 1|Mat.25:1]] ff., [[john 18 3|Jhn.18:3]], [[acts 20 8|Act.20:8]], [[revelation 4 5|Rev.4:5 8:10]].† (AS)

λαμπρός, -ά, -όν (λάμπω), [in LXX: Tob.13:11, Wis.6:12 17:20, Sir.29:22 33:13 (Sir.30:25) Sir.31:23, Ep. Je 60 * ;] bright, brilliant: ποταμός, [[revelation 22 1|Rev.22:1]] (ΕΥ, clear); ἀστήρ, [[revelation 22 16|Rev.22:16;]] of clothing, brilliant, splendid: [[luke 23 11|Luk.23:11]], [[acts 10 30|Act.10:30]], [[james 2 2|Jas.2:2-3]], [[revelation 15 6|Rev.15:6 18:14 19:8]].† (AS)
λαμπρότης, -ητος, ἡ [in LXX: [[psalms 110 3|Psa.110:3]] (הָדָר), al. ;] brightness, brilliancy: τ. ἡλίου, [[acts 26 13|Act.26:13.]]† (AS)
λαμπρῶς adv., splendidly: of sumptuous fare (as freq.; cf. ἐδέσματα λαμπρά, Sir.29:22), [[luke 16 19|Luk.16:19]].† (AS)
λάμπω [in LXX for נָגַהּ, etc. ;] to shine: [[matthew 5 15|Mat.5:15-16 17:2]], [[luke 17 24|Luk.17:24]], [[acts 12 7|Act.12:7]], [[2-corinthians 4 6|2Co.4:6]] (cf. ἐκ-, περι-λάμπω).† (AS)

λανθάνω [in LXX for עָלַם ni., etc. ;] to escape notice, be hidden (from): [[mark 7 24|Mrk.7:24]], [[luke 8 47|Luk.8:47]]; with accusative of person(s), [[acts 26 26|Act.26:26]], [[2-peter 3 5|2Pe.3:5 3:8]]; as in common cl. idiom, before ptcp., ἔλαθον ξενίσαντες, entertained unawares, [[hebrews 13 2|Heb.13:2]] (cf. ἐκ-, ἐπι-λανθάνω).† (AS)

λαξευτός, -ή, όν (λαξεύω; λᾶς, a stone, ξέω, to scrape), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 4 49|Deu.4:49]] (פִּסְגָּה); in Aq.: [[numbers 21 20|Num.21:20;]] Th.: [[judges 7 11|Jdg.7:11]] * ;] hewn (in stone); [[luke 23 53|Luk.23:53]] (elsewhere κοινή writers use λατομητός, [[2-kings 12 12|4Ki.12:12]], al.; cf. λατομέω).† (AS)

λαός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX very frequently for עַם, [[genesis 14 16|Gen.14:16]], al.; occasionally for לְאֹם ( [[genesis 25 23|Gen.25:23]], al.), etc. ;] a word rarely found in Att. prose; 1. the people at large (Hom., al.), esp. of people assembled: [[matthew 27 25|Mat.27:25]], [[luke 1 21|Luk.1:21 3:15]] al.; pl. (Hom., al., π.; see MM, xvi), [[acts 4 27|Act.4:27.]] 2. a people, those of the same race and language (Pind., Æsch., al.: in LXX, [[genesis 26 11|Gen.26:11]], [[exodus 9 16|Exo.9:16]], al.): joined with γλῶσσα, φυλή, ἔθνος, [[revelation 5 9|Rev.5:9 7:9 11:9]], al.; pl., [[luke 2 31|Luk.2:31]], [[romans 15 11|Rom.15:11]]; esp. as almost always in LXX, of Israel, [[matthew 4 23|Mat.4:23]], [[mark 7 6|Mrk.7:6]], [[luke 2 10|Luk.2:10]], [[john 11 50|Jhn.11:50]], [[hebrews 2 17|Heb.2:17]], al.; opposite to τ. ἔθνη, [[acts 26 17|Act.26:17, 23]] [[romans 15 10|Rom.15:10]]; πρεσβύτεροι (πρῶτοι, etc.) τοῦ λ., [[matthew 21 23|Mat.21:23]], [[luke 19 17|Luk.19:17]], [[acts 4 8|Act.4:8]], al.; ὁ λ. μου (αὐτοῦ, τ. θεοῦ), [[matthew 2 6|Mat.2:6]], [[luke 1 68|Luk.1:68]], [[hebrews 11 25|Heb.11:25]], al.; of the people disting. from the rulers and priests ( I [[esther 1 10|Est.1:10]], Jdth.8:9, al.), [[matthew 26 5|Mat.26:5]], [[luke 20 19|Luk.20:19]], [[hebrews 5 3|Heb.5:3]], al.; of Christians, as the people of God, [[acts 15 14|Act.15:14]], [[romans 9 25|Rom.9:25, 26]] [[hebrews 4 9|Heb.4:9]]; περιούσιος, [[titus 2 14|Tit.2:14;]] εἰς περιποίησιν, [[1-peter 2 9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX). SYN.: see: δῆμος. (AS)
Λαοδικία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ Laodicea, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: [[colossians 2 1|Col.2:1 4:13, 15-16]], [[revelation 1 11|Rev.1:11 3:14]].† (AS)
Λαοδικεύς, -έως, ὁ a Laodicean: [[colossians 4 16|Col.4:16.]]† (AS)

λάρυγξ, -γγος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for חֵךְ, [[job 6 30|Job.6:30]], al; [[psalms 5 9|Psa.5:9]] (גָּרוֹן) ;] the larynx, throat: metaphorically, of speech (cf. Sir.6:5), [[romans 3 13|Rom.3:13]]" (LXX) .† (AS)
Λασέα (Rec. -αία), -ας, ἡ Lasea, a city of Crete, otherwise un­known: [[acts 27 8|Act.27:8.]]† (AS)

λάσκω 1. (in cl., poët.) to clang, crash, crack; in late prose, to crack or burst noisily: [[acts 1 18|Act.1:18]] (ἐλάκησεν, perh., however, from λακέω, which see; Bl., in l). 2. (in cl., prose) to scream, shout.† λακέω, Dor. for ληκέω = λάσκω, q.v (AS)

λατομέω, -ῶ (λατόμος, a stonecutter, [[2-kings 12 12|4Ki.12:12]], al.; λᾶς, τέμνω; cf. λαξευτός) [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 22 2|1Ch.22:2]], al. (חָצַב); [[exodus 21 33|Exo.21:33]], Num_21:18 (כָּרָה) ;] to hew, hew out stones: [[matthew 27 60|Mat.27:60]], [[mark 15 46|Mrk.15:46]].† (AS)
